name: Gate steward
design: Towering heavy male with slate-blue speckled hide, domed uncovered head, four thick ivory mandibular tusks, long dense black dreadlocks. Heavy black quilted sleeveless coat over mustard knee tunic, broad bronze collar toggles, large key ring attached to waist, dark calf bindings. One hand grips a loop carrying three chunky gate keys, other rests lightly on belt. Relaxed official posture.
